desc: Ideation: reduce the problem to nonincreasing row prefix lengths and derive the black/white dominance condition.

Implement the row-prefix lower/upper bound method: for each constrained row, compute L_x as the maximum black column and U_x as the minimum white column minus one, then scan constrained rows in descending order while maintaining the maximum L seen so far and check that it never exceeds U_x.
Validate the implementation on the provided sample tests and edge cases such as rows with only black constraints, only white constraints, and same-row conflicts.
